ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic word أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. good evening
   B. I am well
   C. goodbye
   D. I

2. Which reason best explains why we greet one another? (1 mark)
   A. It is only needed when we meet strangers
   B. It shows respect and kindness to the person we meet
   C. It is only needed at school
   D. It is only needed by adults

3. Which Arabic word means "goodbye"? (1 mark)
   A. مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   B. وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ
   C. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
   D. مَرْحَبًا

4. What does the Arabic word خَالَةٌ (khaala) mean? (1 mark)
   A. mother
   B. son
   C. mother's sister
   D. mother's brother

5. What does the Arabic sentence جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my mother.
   B. I have a brother and a sister.
   C. My grandmother loves me.
   D. This is my father.

6. What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a brother and a sister.
   B. This is my father.
   C. My sister reads.
   D. This is my mother.

7. What does the Arabic word خَلْفَ (khalfa) mean? (1 mark)
   A. above
   B. behind
   C. under
   D. beside

8. What does the Arabic word حَقِيبَةٌ (haqiiba) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cup
   B. book
   C. cat
   D. bag

9. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ mean? (1 mark)
   A. There are seven days in a week.
   B. I go to school on Monday.
   C. I play on Saturday.
   D. Today is Thursday.

10. How is the Arabic word غَدًا read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ghadan
   B. madrasa
   C. usbuuʿ
   D. yawm

11. What does the Arabic sentence الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Thursday.
   B. There are seven days in a week.
   C. I go to school on Monday.
   D. I play on Saturday.

12. How is the Arabic word تُفَّاحٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. jazar
   B. samak
   C. shaay
   D. tuffaah

13. What does the Arabic word رَأْسٌ (raʾs) mean? (1 mark)
   A. mouth
   B. shoulder
   C. body
   D. head

14. What does the Arabic word بَارِدٌ (baarid) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cold
   B. rain
   C. weather
   D. hot

15. What does the Arabic sentence فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my room.
   B. In my house there is a kitchen.
   C. Thank you for listening.
   D. I am in Grade 4.

16. What is the name of the Arabic letter غ? (1 mark)
   A. Saad
   B. baa
   C. faa
   D. ghayn

17. What is the name of the Arabic letter ش? (1 mark)
   A. thaa
   B. Haa
   C. ghayn
   D. shiin

18. How do you read the syllable مِ? (1 mark)
   A. buu
   B. mi
   C. da
   D. nu

19. Which strategy uses a picture or the sentence to guess a word? (1 mark)
   A. Clapping
   B. Cues
   C. Decoding only
   D. Copying

20. How do you read the syllable لُ? (1 mark)
   A. ti
   B. su
   C. la
   D. lu

21. What does the Arabic sentence فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is a party.
   B. Above the table there is a balloon.
   C. On the table there is a cake.
   D. The friends are at the party.

22. How does the Arabic comma ، differ from the English comma? (1 mark)
   A. It is a line
   B. It is bigger
   C. It is a dot
   D. It is reversed

23. How is the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. faakiha
   B. tamaatim
   C. shaay
   D. samak

24. How is the Arabic word شَايٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. tamaatim
   B. shaay
   C. khubz
   D. dajaaj

25. What does the word min mean in maTaru mina s-samaa'i? (1 mark)
   A. and
   B. from
   C. on
   D. in

26. How is the Arabic word بِيئَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. zahra
   B. ghaa'im
   C. bii'a
   D. shajara

27. Which is a non-verbal cue? (1 mark)
   A. A dictionary
   B. A gesture
   C. A title
   D. A spelling

28. What does the Arabic sentence الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The chair is at the door.
   B. Do not play with the knife.
   C. The key is in the cupboard.
   D. I read a book on Sunday.

29. What is the name of the Arabic letter ك? (1 mark)
   A. kaaf
   B. ʿayn
   C. DHaa
   D. shiin

30. Which sound does the Arabic letter د make? (1 mark)
   A. s as in sun
   B. d as in dog
   C. f as in fan
   D. m as in mat

31. What sits on the baseline in Arabic writing? (1 mark)
   A. Only the dots
   B. Only the vowels
   C. Most of the letters
   D. Nothing

32. Which Arabic word means "family"? (1 mark)
   A. جَدَّةٌ
   B. أُسْرَةٌ
   C. أُخْتٌ
   D. ابْنٌ

33. Which Arabic word means "mother"? (1 mark)
   A. جَدٌّ
   B. بِنْتٌ
   C. أَبٌ
   D. أُمٌّ

34. What is a good way to give feedback on someone's handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. Say something good first, then give one tip
   B. Say nothing
   C. Tear the page
   D. Laugh at it

35. Which Arabic word means "small"? (1 mark)
   A. صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ
   B. خَالَةٌ
   C. قَدَمٌ
   D. صَغِيرٌ

36. Which Arabic word means "Monday"? (1 mark)
   A. غَدًا
   B. الثُّلَاثَاءُ
   C. الْيَوْمَ
   D. الِاثْنَيْنِ

37. Which Arabic word means "rice"? (1 mark)
   A. سُكَّرٌ
   B. لَحْمٌ
   C. شَايٌ
   D. أَرُزٌّ

38. What does aghsilu wajhii mean? (1 mark)
   A. I write with my hand.
   B. I wash my face.
   C. My head is big.
   D. I clean my teeth.

39. Which word do you use for 'This is ...' before a feminine word such as shams? (1 mark)
   A. haadhihi
   B. haadhaa
   C. ayna
   D. man

40. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like my house.
   B. In the kitchen there is a table.
   C. This is my room.
   D. In the room there is a bed.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: ashrabu l-haliiba (2 marks)

42. Describe how to make a food chart for the class wall. (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Explain why a speaker should practise before speaking to an audience. (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i (2 marks)

45. Write the seven days in Arabic sounds and say what the first five names come from. (5 marks) (5 marks)

46. Write one Arabic sentence about your body in sounds and translate it. (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Read these sentences and give the day for each activity: (a) adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (b) alʿabu yawma s-sabt (c) aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad. (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Explain how the same Arabic word can look different but keep its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Match these to their Arabic names: chair, bed, kitchen. Write the sounds. (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into English: aghsilu wajhii (2 marks)

51. Translate into English: shukran li-istimaaʿikum (2 marks)

52. Sort these words into items and position words: kitaab, ʿalaa, taawila, taHta. (4 marks) (4 marks)

53. Look at a picture of a birthday party with a cake with a candle and friends standing round the table. Make a prediction and give a reason. (2 marks) (2 marks)

54. Translate into English: anaa araa biʿaynii (2 marks)

55. Write four parts of the body in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

56. Explain why vocabulary building helps you to learn Arabic. (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Explain how the voice should sound in a statement and in a question. (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. List the members of the nuclear family in Arabic (English letters) with their meanings. Give at least four. (4 marks) (4 marks)

59. Give three questions you could ask when you give peer feedback on a friend's fluency. (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into English: kayfa haaluki? (2 marks)

61. Translate into English: usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt (2 marks)

62. Describe the steps of making a class picture book on family celebrations. (4 marks) (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — I am well
   أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) means I am well.

2. B — It shows respect and kindness to the person we meet
   A greeting is for everyone. It shows that we see and respect the other person.

3. A — مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

4. C — mother's sister
   خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

5. C — My grandmother loves me.
   جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي (jaddatii tuhibbunii) means: My grandmother loves me.

6. C — My sister reads.
   أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ (ukhtii taqraʾu) means: My sister reads.

7. B — behind
   خَلْفَ (khalfa) means behind.

8. D — bag
   حَقِيبَةٌ (haqiiba) means bag.

9. A — There are seven days in a week.
   فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ (fii l-usbuuʿi sabʿatu ayyaam) means: There are seven days in a week.

10. A — ghadan
   غَدًا is read ghadan and means tomorrow.

11. A — Today is Thursday.
   الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

12. D — tuffaah
   تُفَّاحٌ is read tuffaah and means apples.

13. D — head
   رَأْسٌ (raʾs) means head.

14. A — cold
   بَارِدٌ (baarid) means cold.

15. B — In my house there is a kitchen.
   فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ (fii baytii matbakh) means: In my house there is a kitchen.

16. D — ghayn
   The letter غ is called ghayn.

17. D — shiin
   The letter ش is called shiin.

18. B — mi
   مِ is read mi.

19. B — Cues
   Cues are clues such as pictures and the words around the new word.

20. D — lu
   لُ is read lu.

21. B — Above the table there is a balloon.
   فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ (fawqa t-taawilati baaluun) means: Above the table there is a balloon.

22. D — It is reversed
   The Arabic comma and question mark are reversed because the script goes right to left.

23. B — tamaatim
   طَمَاطِمُ is read tamaatim and means tomatoes.

24. B — shaay
   شَايٌ is read shaay and means tea.

25. B — from
   min means 'from', so 'the rain is from the sky'.

26. C — bii'a
   بِيئَةٌ is read bii'a and means environment.

27. B — A gesture
   Gestures, facial expressions and body movements are non-verbal cues.

28. C — The key is in the cupboard.
   الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ (al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana) means: The key is in the cupboard.

29. A — kaaf
   The letter ك is called kaaf.

30. B — d as in dog
   The letter د makes the sound d as in dog.

31. C — Most of the letters
   Most letters rest on the baseline. Alif stands tall above it.

32. B — أُسْرَةٌ
   أُسْرَةٌ (usra) means family.

33. D — أُمٌّ
   أُمٌّ (umm) means mother.

34. A — Say something good first, then give one tip
   Kind and helpful feedback encourages a friend to improve.

35. D — صَغِيرٌ
   صَغِيرٌ (Sagiir) means small.

36. D — الِاثْنَيْنِ
   الِاثْنَيْنِ (al-ithnayn) means Monday.

37. D — أَرُزٌّ
   أَرُزٌّ (aruzz) means rice.

38. B — I wash my face.
   aghsilu means I wash and wajhii means my face.

39. A — haadhihi
   haadhihi is used with feminine words and haadhaa with masculine words.

40. B — In the kitchen there is a table.
   فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink milk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Draw local foods, write the Arabic name under each picture, colour it and post it on the wall for review.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for drawing, 1 mark for labels and 1 mark for posting or review.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Practice helps the speaker to remember words, pronounce them correctly and feel less nervous.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for remembering or pronouncing and 1 mark for confidence.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is in the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt. The first five come from the numbers one to five.
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for the days (2 for five or six, 1 for three or four) and 2 marks for the numbers clue.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example aktubu bi-yadii. I write with my hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for the translation.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) Monday (b) Saturday (c) Sunday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: In different writing styles the letter shapes change a little, but the letters, sounds and meaning stay the same.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for shapes change and 1 mark for meaning stays the same.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: chair is kursii, bed is sariir, kitchen is matbakh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: I wash my face.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thank you for listening.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Items: kitaab (book), taawila (table). Position words: ʿalaa (on), taHta (under).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word placed correctly.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends will sing and eat the cake, because the cake has a candle and they stand round the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sensible prediction and 1 mark for a reason from the picture.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: I see with my eye.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example raʾs (head), ʿayn (eye), fam (mouth), yad (hand).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: The more words you know, the more you can understand, say and write. Grouping words by theme helps you to remember them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for understanding, 1 mark for speaking or writing and 1 mark for remembering.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: In a statement the voice falls at the end. In a question it rises at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct description.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), ibn (son), bint (daughter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning, up to 4.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Were the words clear? Was the speed steady? Did the voice fall for statements and rise for questions?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each suitable question.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: How are you? (to a girl)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: I help my mother on Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

62. (4 marks)
   Answer: Collect or draw pictures of celebration things; put one on each page; write an Arabic word or sentence with the meaning; make a cover with a title.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.
